svg.title: Tingling, numbness or weakness around the elbow: true sensory loss means a nerve; ulnar neuropathy at the elbow is worked up with Tinel sign, an ulnar sensory map, hand muscle strength and EMG/NCS, and managed with education, avoiding pressure and hyperflexion, then surgery; pronator syndrome compresses the median nerve at pronator teres
